item.title: HIV Hiding Spot Discovery
item.description:
• Summary: Scientists have uncovered a new hiding spot for HIV, as reported by STAT News. This discovery reveals previously unknown cellular reservoirs where the virus can persist despite antiretroviral therapy, complicating efforts to achieve a cure. Identifying these sanctuary sites is a critical step toward developing strategies to eliminate latent HIV and achieve long-term remission or eradication.
